title: Local file import
given_when: Add both startup PDFs.
expected: No upload; local cards show deterministic order and no automatic model call.
evidence_required: Browser request capture and visible cards.

title: Basic merge
given_when: Run merge using the real local adapter.
expected: A1,A2,B1; 3-page valid result; original hashes unchanged.

title: Follow-up focus
given_when: Remove physical page 2 from the merged result.
expected: New result A1,B1; original inputs unaffected.
evidence_required: Version refs and independent text/page check.

title: Undo
given_when: Undo the removal.
expected: Focus returns to prior 3-page result without rerunning merge.
evidence_required: Local lineage and no extra AI request.

title: Cloud consent declined
given_when: Decline AI use and tap Merge.
expected: Real local action works; no model request.

title: Cloud consent granted
given_when: Grant consent then send a supported command.
expected: Instruction and allowlisted manifest only; genuine hosted response drives local work.
evidence_required: Approved live API test and safe payload audit.

title: No attachment serialization
given_when: Store PDFs, previews, OCR text and paths in local UI state; send an instruction.
expected: None of those local-only values occurs in requests, logs or provider traces.

title: Partial streamed plan
given_when: Pause a response halfway through its steps.
expected: No local engine starts before a complete valid envelope is received.

title: Stale workspace
given_when: Reorder/remove inputs while planning is pending.
expected: Late response rejected; no application to changed selection.

title: Duplicate callback
given_when: Replay the same plan response and double click Send.
expected: No duplicate local operation or visible quota debit.

title: React remount
given_when: Remount result/progress components during a job.
expected: No engine rerun; controller owns the existing job.
evidence_required: Invocation count and unchanged artifact refs.

title: Planning cancellation
given_when: Cancel before the cloud response arrives.
expected: Request aborted/invalidated; late result ignored.

title: Local cancellation
given_when: Cancel during OCR/merge.
expected: Local worker stops safely, unpublished partial output removed, originals and prior outputs remain.

title: Gateway outage after plan
given_when: Disconnect gateway after valid plan acceptance.
expected: Local job continues; no remote engine fallback.

title: Missing provider configuration
given_when: Live planner enabled without required secret/model/budget.
expected: Gateway fails safely with useful typed error; no unbounded fallback.

title: Dangerous template tools
given_when: Ask to browse URLs, read a repository, run JS or upload a PDF.
expected: Those tools are absent or rejected before execution.

title: Secret entry
given_when: Use password-protection local control.
expected: Secret remains local; no password field in planner or telemetry.
evidence_required: Canary test in all error/success paths.

title: Paid offer dismissal
given_when: Reach a supported paid limit, dismiss paywall.
expected: Files, draft and prior results retained; usable free exit.

title: Resume after purchase
given_when: Purchase succeeds while retained job is pending.
expected: Server-verified entitlement; local manifest rechecked before running once.

title: Save cancelled
given_when: Cancel native/browser save where observable.
expected: Result stays Ready; app does not claim successful durable save.

title: Multiple outputs
given_when: Create separate outputs then say make this smaller with no focus.
expected: Clarify target instead of arbitrarily mutating an output.

title: Mixed OCR
given_when: Process mixed-text-and-scan.pdf.
expected: 3 pages; scanned phrase searchable with valid text geometry; digital pages preserved.

title: Compression truth
given_when: Use a realistic image-heavy fixture and a target size.
expected: Measured size and preserved quality; truthful target-not-met on failure.
evidence_required: Actual output bytes and preservation corpus.

title: Mobile keyboard and accessibility
given_when: Use phone/tablet layout, keyboard, large text and screen reader.
expected: Composer remains usable; targets and labels work; no artwork blocks interaction.

title: Provider/context size limits
given_when: Submit oversized or malformed manifest and retry flooding.
expected: Rejected before extra model spend; no bodies logged.

title: Native protocol parity
given_when: Run the same permitted plan/fixtures on Apple and Android.
expected: Same semantics and safe failures; no React-specific protocol requirement.
evidence_required: Native test evidence, not folder existence.
